title: Can't Hold My Feelings
style: Dramatic alternative rock with a slow-building intro that erupts into powerful, guitar-driven choruses. Overdriven rhythm guitars play wide, sustaining chords and syncopated accents, supported by a tight, melodic bass line and punchy, arena-style drums with emphatic tom fills and crashing cymbals. The vocals are passionate and raw, starting in a restrained mid-range and rising into strained, emotional belts with layered harmonies on the hooks. Occasional clean arpeggio guitar lines and atmospheric pads add tension between sections, creating a sense of emotional overload and cathartic release.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I bite my tongue till it starts to bleed
Turn every shout to a silent scream
I wear a mask so they never see
The storm that’s waking up inside of me
I play it cool like it’s all okay
But every breath is about to break
I’m shaking under this empty smile
I’ve been holding back for a long, long while

[Pre-Chorus]
Every heartbeat’s getting louder
Like a drum inside my chest
I keep drowning in the pressure
But there’s nothing left to left

[Chorus]
I can’t hold my feelings in
They’re breaking through my skin
Like thunder in my veins, I’m crashing
I can’t fake this smile again
This flood is gonna win
I’m done with hiding, done with acting
I can’t hold my feelings in
I can’t hold my feelings in

[Verse 2]
I chase the dark with an empty light
I paint the truth in a softer white
But all the cracks in the walls I build
Are letting every buried secret spill
I hear my doubt like a distant roar
It shakes the locks on a rusted door
I’m standing here with these shaking hands
With words I never thought I’d ever stand

[Pre-Chorus]
Every heartbeat’s getting louder
Like a drum inside my chest
I keep drowning in the pressure
But there’s nothing left to left

[Chorus]
I can’t hold my feelings in
They’re breaking through my skin
Like thunder in my veins, I’m crashing
I can’t fake this smile again
This flood is gonna win
I’m done with hiding, done with acting
I can’t hold my feelings in
I can’t hold my feelings in

[Bridge]
All these walls I made
Are caving in tonight
Every truth I’ve saved
Is screaming for the light
I’m a ticking bomb
I can feel the spark
I won’t stay calm
In the falling dark

[Breakdown]
I won’t stay silent, I won’t stay small (yeah)
These heavy feelings, I’ll let them fall (let them fall)
I’ve been a prisoner in my own head (own head)
But I’m breaking out of this skin I shed

[Chorus]
I can’t hold my feelings in
They’re breaking through my skin
Like thunder in my veins, I’m crashing
I can’t fake this smile again
This flood is gonna win
I’m done with hiding, done with acting
I can’t hold my feelings in
I can’t hold my feelings in

[Outro]
I can’t hold my feelings in
No more walls to keep them in
Let the silence turn to screaming
This is me, this is me, finally breathing
I can’t hold my feelings in
I can’t hold my feelings in
